content.rendered:
Archer Glen Supply Night is right around the corner! 

On Thursday, August 30th from 4:00 – 6:00 pm we will have an Open House time for students to bring in their school supplies and meet their teacher and classmates for the 2018-2019 school year. Please plan on 15 to 20 minutes per classroom visit.

Kindergarten students will bring their supplies to the Kindergarten Pod and parents will be asked to fill out some paperwork.
The Archer Glen PAC Board, Transportation, Food Services and other representatives will be available in the lobby to answer questions and help with Background Check sign-ups and bus and lunch information.
